item.title: 4.1-magnitude earthquake jolts parts of country
item.description: A 4.1-magnitude earthquake was felt in the south-western region of the country.The epicenter wasSatkhira's Kolaroa. And the depth from the center was 150 kilometers.The tremor occurred at 04:36AM, according to India's National Centre for Seismology (NCS).There have been no immediate reports of structural damage or casualties.TF

item.title: Tibetan spiritual leader Dalai Lama earns historic Grammy at 90
item.description: At 90, the 14th Dalai Lama, Tenzin Gyatso, has won his first-ever Grammy Award, adding a new milestone to his long list of global honours.The Tibetan spiritual leader received the accolade in the Best Audio Book, Narration & Storytelling Recording category for his spoken-word album Meditations: The Reflections of His Holiness the Dalai Lama.The award was accepted on his behalf by musician Rufus Wainwright, who collaborated on the project. item.title: 440 centres in Gazipur marked risky out of 935
item.description: A total of 935 polling centers have been set up across five parliamentary constituencies of Gazipur ahead of the national parliamentary election. Among these, 440 centers have been marked as 'risky'.Within the Gazipur Metropolitan area, there are 400 polling centers, of which 227 have been marked as 'risky'. item.title: Aslam Chowdhury, Sarwar cleared to contest polls
item.description: The Appellate Division of the Supreme Court on Tuesday ruled that BNP candidates for the Chattogram-4 constituency Aslam Chowdhury and Chattogram-2 seat Sarwar Alamgir can contest the upcoming 13th National Parliamentary Election.
